description: You can pass several options to the Incus container hypervisor that will affect the container's capabilities.

incus:nested_allowed.title: Allow nested containers
incus:nested_allowed.description: Allow or disallow creation of nested containers. If True, you can install and run Incus inside the VM itself and provision another level of containers.

incus:privileged_allowed.title: Create privileged container
incus:privileged_allowed.description: Containers created as Privileged have elevated powers on the compute host. You should not set this option on containers that you don't fully trust.
